anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convex curve with a large radius of curvature across the anterior-dorsal cranial surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak profile with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse interior angle at the pixel junction where the descending melon slope meets the horizontal dorsal rostrum line.
